vermilion.purpose: The sole graphic accent; not for small text.

narrative.overview: This is a deliberately small identity for the hello-bolt Slack demonstration: one accent, one connected sharp diagonal form, and plain supporting language. It gives the app a recognizable square-crop avatar without turning a developer demo into a mascot brand. Its scope is the demo identity only. Whether it becomes the framework's permanent identity remains undecided.
keyCharacteristics: One original notched diagonal contact, drawn as a single SVG path.
One vermilion accent held against paper and ink.
Sparse, functional labelling; no ornamental AI imagery.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is the only accent; do not add supporting colors to decorate the mark.

dos: Do use the generated square avatar exports for Slack app imagery.
Do reproduce assets from the PHP source and preserve the three named color tokens.
Do use ink on paper for small readable text.
donts: Don't treat the brand-sheet label as a wordmark or infer a brand typeface from it.
Don't use vermilion for small text or add another accent color.
Don't turn the contact into generic AI imagery, a mascot, or an illustrated character.
